title: Shop roof repair
transcript:
Rosa Delgado (owner): The leak over the stockroom cannot wait.
Rosa Delgado (owner): I'll pay Ridge Roofing $1,200 for the shop roof repair.
Rosa Delgado (owner): They can start on the 12th.

traps.description: The quote is the real $1,200 sentence, but the draft says $1,500.
traps.quote: I'll pay Ridge Roofing $1,200 for the shop roof repair.

traps.description: The draft quotes a sentence about $1,500 that Rosa never said.
traps.quote: I'll pay Ridge Roofing $1,500 for the shop roof repair.
